title: Three.js
summary: Low-poly 3D drawn like a comic panel: flat cel shading in three hard bands with violet shadows and a warm rim, ink outlines from a hand-written edge pass, halftone skies and a striped sun.

items.name: Sunset drive
items.description: A low-poly car on a coast road, palms sweeping past, a striped sun dead ahead.

items.name: Coast skyline
items.description: Stepped pastel towers with lit windows behind sand, palms and water, as the camera drifts along the shore.

items.name: Speedboat
items.description: A speedboat throwing a white V wake across teal water toward a far shoreline.

items.name: Chopper sweep
items.description: A helicopter circling over lit city blocks at night, sweeping a spotlight.

items.name: Neon sign
items.description: A palm, a sun and a line of script switching on tube by tube on a brick wall.

items.name: Coin spin
items.description: A fat gold coin spinning in front of a sunburst with smaller coins circling.

items.name: Palm horizon
items.description: Rows of palms sliding past a huge striped sun at different speeds, with birds.

items.name: Cash rain
items.description: Banknotes and coins tumbling down in front of a turning sunburst.

items.name: Reel billboards
items.description: Driving a sunset coast road lined with billboards, each showing one of the creator's real reel covers (props.images: URLs; they repeat), rushing past on both sides. props.speed. Not a loop.

items.name: Cop chase
items.description: Two low-poly police cruisers tearing down a night road toward the camera, light bars strobing red and blue, palms and towers whipping past. props.strobe (flashes a second). Loops.

items.name: Screen city
items.description: A dusk skyline where giant rooftop screens switch on one after another, one per platform, in that platform's colour with a short mark (props.platforms [{mark, name, color}], props.times). Simple lettering, not logo artwork.

items.name: Drone city flight
items.description: An FPV drone flight: street level looking up at a pink tower, lifting past its roof while swinging round over the whole city, then banking into a dive down an avenue of towers and palms. Full frame. props.seconds = the flight's length.
